description: The bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each of seven evaluation criteria when assessing a generative-AI-driven claim retrieval system, as described in the paper “A Generative-AI-Driven Claim Retrieval System Capable of Detecting and Retrieving Claims from Social Media Platforms in Multiple Languages.” The vertical axis lists the criteria in descending order of participant selection: “Relevant FCs” (5 participants), “FC Summary” (3), “Relevance Explanation” (3), “Clarity and Simplicity” (2), “Overall Summary” (1), “Filters” (1), and “Veracity Explanation” (1). The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” ranges from 0 to 6 with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each criterion is represented by a horizontal bar colored in a distinct shade of green or blue, with the length of the bar corresponding to the number of participants who selected it; the bar for “Relevant FCs” is the longest, extending to 5, while those for “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation” are the shortest, each reaching only 1. The chart is oriented diagonally, with the bars slanting upward to the right, and no additional annotations or error bars are present.
